topics.prompt: how do you talk to people naturally without feeling awkward
topics.core: Just be genuinely curious about them, smile, and talk the way you would with a close friend over coffee—nobody expects a rehearsed script.

topics.prompt: what should i do when i have too much on my plate
topics.core: Pick just the one smallest thing you can finish in ten minutes and ignore the rest for now. Once you get one win, the stress drops way down.

topics.prompt: how do i cheer up a friend who is having a rough week
topics.core: Sometimes just checking in, listening without trying to fix everything right away, and reminding them you are in their corner means the world.

topics.prompt: why is it nice to just chat casually sometimes
topics.core: Everyday conversation helps us unwind, share a laugh, and bounce ideas around without any pressure.
